index_stage_rule: formula query results are quarantined index candidates; no 2D, training, D1, D2 or discovery status is assigned
next_gate: apply the fixed stability prefilter, then retrieve structures for explicit MP IDs and perform per-record dimensionality and method audits
anti_leakage_rule: no uncertainty-weight tuning or strategy scoring is allowed on the validation formulas before the validation protocol is frozen
